name: HELLDIVERS 2
notes: Build 24826606: use the Apple Metal 3 path. No extra launch arguments are required. The DX11 flag failed startup on the tested DXMT/DXVK paths and is not applied.

driver.guidance: With an Apple backend, reports compatibility version 35.0.15.6094 instead of the invalid all-65535 value. This is not an actual driver update. Requires the driver-compatible runtime; the preference is inactive with DXMT/DXVK.

capture.guidance: Validated for Helldivers 2 to prevent Dock-edge cursor exposure. Select Fullscreen inside the game; capture does not change resolution or create a macOS Space.

fullscreenSpace.guidance: Select Fullscreen inside Helldivers. The optional Space keeps the full display area, including behind the notch, and closes when the game window closes. Changes apply at the next launch.
